Bug_Title: Min and max used in combination should not always return the same value
Bug_Explanation: The bug is caused by using Math.min() with the LOWER bound and Math.max() with the UPPER bound, which always results in the UPPER bound being returned, regardless of the input number.
Trigger_Explanation: The JUnit test cases trigger the bug by passing in various numbers to the showBug method. The bug causes the method to incorrectly return 20 regardless of the input number because of the improper use of Math.min and Math.max, which always results in returning the UPPER bound (20).
